## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check:dash`, `npm run check:placeholders`, `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npx tsc -b` and `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run test:site` (100% coverage)
- [ ] `npm run build:site`, and `npm run e2e` for site changes
- [ ] Docs on every surface that changed: READMEs, site, wiki, project board
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, account ids or personal data in code, docs or tests
